data.title: NKB Inc.: Limited Edition: High-Definition Giclée Prints of Katsuhiro Otomo’s Ginza Station Public Art “Procession Spin” Now Available
data.description: In Tokyo, NKB Inc. has released high-definition Giclée prints of "Procession Spin," a ceramic relief public art piece by manga artist and director Katsuhiro Otomo. Each print, from an exclusive collection overseen by Otomo, is hand-signed and numbered. Headquartered in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, NKB's President, Takayuki Toya, led the project. The prints are based on Otomo's original artwork and aim to capture the essence of "Procession Spin." The collection features a limited edition of prints, each carrying a unique number assigned by Otomo.

data.title: Epsilon Energy Ltd. Announces Quarterly Dividend
data.description: Epsilon Energy Ltd. disclosed today that its Board of Directors has approved a dividend of $0.0625 per common stock share (equating to an annualized amount of $0.25 per share) for shareholders on record as of September 15, 2026. The dividend will be disbursed on September 30, 2026. It is worth noting that all dividends issued by the Company are classified as "eligible dividends" under subsection 89(1) of the Income Tax Act (Canada), unless stated otherwise. Epsilon is listed on the NASDAQ exchange under the symbol EPSN.

data.title: New Pit Master Takes Over San Bernardino Dickey’s, Brings Fresh Perspective to Hometown Restaurant
data.description: In Los Angeles, the San Bernardino community will see a change in ownership at their Dickey’s Barbecue Pit as Tuan “Danny” Nguyen steps in as the new owner of the restaurant situated at 1725 Northpark Blvd. W., Suite A1. Taking on the role of Pit Master, Nguyen, a local resident, commenced his duties earlier this summer. Thrilled about the opportunity to showcase his love for barbecue, hospitality, and community engagement, Nguyen is eager to strengthen the restaurant's ties with the local residents.

data.title: Ant International Secures Payment Institution Licence from the Central Bank of Brazil
data.description: Ant International, a top global provider of digital payment, digitization, and FinAI solutions, has recently acquired a Payment Institution (PI) license from the Central Bank of Brazil. This development allows them to enhance their global payment and account services for enterprises, platforms, and SMEs operating in Brazil’s thriving digital economy. This license solidifies their position as a key player in the industry and showcases their commitment to expanding their services in the country.

data.title: Eightpoint Technologies Joins Enterprise Cayman and DMZ as Programme Partner for Launch Labs Incubator
data.description: Eightpoint Technologies Ltd. SEZC has announced its participation in a new 14-week program set to connect 18 ventures with mentorship, expertise, and networking opportunities to foster accelerated growth. The program is aimed at supporting scalable growth for various ventures. Based in George Town, Cayman Islands, Eightpoint will play a crucial role in providing resources for this initiative, which is set to begin on September 4, 2026. This program signifies a significant step towards fostering innovation and growth within the entrepreneurial ecosystem.

data.title: CreditRefresh Members Challenge More Than 1,000 Potential Credit Report Errors in First Month
data.description: Credit Refresh LLC has introduced cutting-edge AI technology and the ability for consumers to have complete control over the typically intricate dispute process. The company, based in DOVER, Del., made this announcement on September 4, 2026. Through their AI-powered platform, Credit Refresh members have utilized CreditRefresh to contest a higher number of disputes effectively.

data.title: Bamboo Insurance Launches Texas Essential Homeowner Program, with Flexible, Affordable Coverage Options
data.description: A Texas Essential Homeowner Program has been introduced by Bamboo Insurance, providing homeowners in Texas with increased flexibility and control over their coverage options. The product was unveiled on September 4, 2026 in Midvale, Utah. This new offering aims to give policyholders more choice in structuring their insurance policies. Bamboo Insurance Services, LLC is behind this initiative, allowing Texas residents to tailor their coverage to suit their individual needs. This program is set to provide significant benefits to homeowners in Texas, marking a significant milestone in the insurance industry for the state.

data.title: VEVOR Steps Offline in Europe at IFA Berlin 2026, with First European Store Planned in France for 2027
